requirement.description: The build_netlist function in ir.py is encountering AttributeError when trying to process tuples from AST nodes. Several test cases fail with "AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'items'" indicating the code expects dictionary-like objects but receives tuples.
requirement.contract: Function build_netlist should properly handle AST node representations that are tuples instead of dictionaries. It should correctly process and convert tuple-based AST representations into the appropriate netlist format.

requirement.description: MemoryData and related classes are not properly handling the repr() representation. Test cases like test_row are expecting specific tuple formats like "(memory-row (memory-data data) 2)" but the current implementation isn't returning the correct representation.
requirement.contract: MemoryData class should properly implement __repr__ to return the expected tuple format for memory row representations.

requirement.description: Several test cases are failing due to mismatched error messages and incorrect validation behavior. Specifically, tests expect specific error message formats but get different ones, and some validation checks aren't triggering warnings as expected.
requirement.contract: Error messages should match the expected format exactly and validation warnings should be triggered when appropriate.

requirement.description: Memory constructor and related methods have incorrect validation and error messages. Tests expect specific error messages for invalid configurations but get different messages.
requirement.contract: Memory constructor and related validation methods should produce the exact error messages expected by the test suite.

requirement.description: Some tests are failing because the code expects certain exception types to be raised but they are not being raised, or they are raising different exception types than expected.
requirement.contract: Specific error conditions should raise the expected exception types with correct messages.
